notes: The כִּי opening the quotation is unrendered in the ASV text (its margin reads 'Truly'), so it is unrepresented rather than folded into a neighbouring word.
'how then' splits: אֵיךְ takes 'how' and the waw takes 'then'; because the interrogative has an English word of its own, the fronted 'can' stays with the verb under rule 17's second limit.
